   **Errores y estabilidad.**
      5 reseñas recientes mencionan errores y estabilidad.
      Ventana de reseñas: 29 may 2026 - 12 jul 2026
      **Por qué importa:** Los usuarios mencionan crashes o inestabilidad. Trátalo como accionable solo si el volumen sube o sigue a una update; si no, suele ser ruido baseline.

         **Ejemplos de reseñas:**
            1. _Isemran_, 9 jul 2026, 1/5: "Keeps crashing on both my iPhone and iPad. Tried many time contacting Microsoft but there was no response. Too bad"
            2. _tomspee_, 2 jul 2026, 1/5: "When adding an item the app is very slow and looks like item is added on main thread and rest is blocked. Quickly adding items is not possible. Sometimes when I open a list an item is automatically completed while I didn’t tap it. Please make all heavy lifting to be done on background thread and not block the UI."
            3. _krullert_, 2 jul 2026, 3/5: "Sorting (drag and drop) is broken since last update. Making the app barely usable"
